question: Which café lie within 160 kilometers along the east axis from Mario & Alberto De La Cruz Art Gallery, Washington, DC?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.070132 38.906035)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.070132 38.906035)',4326)::geography, 160000)
AND amenity = 'cafe'
AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5;

[3].display_name: Mario & Alberto De La Cruz Art Gallery, Washington, DC

poi.poi_name: Mario & Alberto De La Cruz Art Gallery
